newsitem.title: HONG KONG: UPS new Taiwan hub opened Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: UPS new Taiwan hub opened Wednesday.

text.p: United Parcel Service officially opened its Asia hub in Taiwan on Wednesday, a company statement said.
The hub at Taipei's Chiang Kai Shek airport is the company's third major international air hub and UPS said it is the first international express company to establish a hub in Taiwan.

UPS said the $400 million hub represents the company's largest single investment in the Asia Pacific region. UPS uses DC-8 and Boeing 747 aircraft in Asia but Boeing 757 and 767 are to be added to the Asian freighter fleet and will be based in Taiwan.
The company said the hub will be able to provide later daily pick up times and earlier deliveries to major cities throughout the world.
UPS's Asian network covers Singapore, South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
